text_simplified: Justice among children is one of the most important foundations of sound tarbiyah (upbringing). If a parent does not act justly among their children, enmity, envy, and anger will grow between them. However, if they are careful to be just, they will earn their children’s love and birr al-walidayn (righteousness toward parents). It is reported in the hadith that the Prophet ﷺ said to the man who favored one of his children: 'Fear Allah and be just among your children' (Sahih al-Bukhari 2587).
